boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Carroll University
boards.description: Discover the essential late-night food and study spots that define the student experience at Carroll University in Waukesha.

cards.title: Crave at Carroll
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Campus Dining
cards.notes: Located in Frontier Hall, this spot offers a full menu for dine-in or carry-out until 9 p.m. daily, accepting Carroll Cash and meal plans.
cards.short_summary: A primary on-campus dining location in Frontier Hall open until 9 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Crave at Carroll in Frontier Hall is open 7 a.m.-9 p.m. daily and accepts meal plans and Carroll Cash.
cards.source_title: Dining Services Locations and Information - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 9:00 PM during the academic year.

cards.title: Stone Creek Coffee at Todd Wehr
cards.subtitle: Library Study Fuel
cards.notes: Fuel your late-night study sessions at the Todd Wehr Memorial Library location, open until 9 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.short_summary: A local coffee favorite situated inside the Todd Wehr Memorial Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Stone Creek Coffee in Todd Wehr Memorial Library is open 7:30 a.m.-9 p.m. Monday-Thursday.
cards.source_title: Dining Services Locations and Information - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM Monday-Thursday; limited weekend hours.

cards.title: Campus Center
cards.subtitle: The Center of Everything
cards.notes: The hub for student life, the Campus Center stays open until 11:30 p.m. on weekdays and 12:30 a.m. on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.short_summary: The central student hub offering late-night access to lounges and resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Center is open Monday–Thursday until 11:30 p.m. and Friday–Saturday until 12:30 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:30 PM Sun-Thu and 12:30 AM Fri-Sat.

cards.title: Toppers Pizza
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Topperstix
cards.notes: A classic Wisconsin late-night tradition, this location serves signature Topperstix and pizza until 1:55 a.m. for pickup and delivery.
cards.short_summary: A popular late-night pizza chain known for its cheesy Topperstix.
cards.evidence_claim: Toppers Pizza on N Grandview Blvd has online ordering hours until 1:55 AM.
cards.source_title: Toppers Pizza Waukesha North - Order Online
cards.access_notes: Open for delivery and pickup until 1:55 AM daily.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Sunset
cards.subtitle: Drive-Thru Fourth Meal
cards.notes: Located just south of campus, the drive-thru at this Sunset Drive location remains open until 2 a.m. for late-night cravings.
cards.short_summary: A reliable fast-food option with late-night drive-thru hours near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 405 W Sunset Dr features drive-thru hours until 2:00 AM on Mondays (and similar late hours daily).
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Waukesha, WI - 405 W Sunset Dr
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until 2:00 AM.

cards.title: McDonald's on Moreland
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Golden Arches
cards.notes: This East Moreland Blvd location provides a 24-hour drive-thru option for students needing a meal at any hour of the night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour fast-food staple located a short drive from the university.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 2340 E Moreland Blvd operates a 24-hour drive-thru.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Waukesha, WI at 2340 E Moreland Blvd | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is open 24 hours.

cards.title: Kwik Trip
cards.subtitle: Wisconsin's 24/7 Pantry
cards.notes: A regional favorite for 24-hour snacks, fresh fruit, and Glazers donuts, perfect for a quick midnight supply run.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store and gas station offering fresh food and coffee.
cards.evidence_claim: Kwik Trip locations, such as the one on River Valley Rd, are open 24 hours a day.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Einstein Bros. Bagels
cards.subtitle: Campus Center Dining
cards.notes: Located in the Campus Center, Einstein's serves sandwiches and coffee until 7 p.m. daily, providing an early evening dining option.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus bagel and coffee shop located in the Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Einstein Bros. Bagels in the Campus Center is open until 7 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Dining Services Locations and Information - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Open until 7:00 PM daily.

cards.title: Jimmy John's
cards.subtitle: Freaky Fast Delivery
cards.notes: The Grand Avenue location offers quick sandwich delivery to campus until 10 p.m., ideal for late-night study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A sandwich shop providing fast delivery and pickup options near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jimmy John's on Grand Ave in Waukesha typically serves until 10:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Jimmy John's Locations in Waukesha, Wisconsin
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM for delivery and pickup.

cards.title: Perkins Restaurant & Bakery
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Breakfast
cards.notes: A classic choice for late-night breakfast or pie, this casual diner is a short drive from campus and open until 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A family-style restaurant known for all-day breakfast and bakery items.
cards.evidence_claim: Perkins Restaurant & Bakery locations in the region typically operate until 10:00 PM or later.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM daily.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional student hubs and quiet corners of Carroll University, from specialized sensory study rooms to historic practice spaces and late-night fitness centers.

cards.title: Sensory Study Room 206
cards.subtitle: Todd Wehr Memorial Library
cards.notes: Book this specialized room on the second floor for a low-stimulation environment designed for neurodiverse students needing a quiet, controlled study space.
cards.short_summary: A low-stimulation study room in the library designed for neurodiverse students.
cards.evidence_claim: Room 206 is a designated Sensory Study Room on the 2nd floor of the library, bookable for up to 4 hours per day.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Library - Reserve a Room
cards.access_notes: Reservations required via LibCal; priority given to students with sensory processing needs.

cards.title: Ganfield Gymnasium Studio 201A
cards.subtitle: Historic Athletic Hub
cards.notes: Head upstairs to room 201A for free group fitness classes like Zumba, led by YMCA instructors for all Carroll students.
cards.short_summary: An upstairs studio in the historic gym hosting free group fitness classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Group fitness classes are held in Ganfield Gymnasium Studio (Room 201A) and are free for students with registration.
cards.access_notes: Registration via IMLeagues app required; open during scheduled class times.

cards.title: Shattuck Music Center Practice Rooms
cards.subtitle: Self-Contained Practice Suite
cards.notes: Utilize the self-contained suite of practice rooms and 21 grand pianos available for student use regardless of major.
cards.short_summary: A suite of music practice rooms available to all students in the Shattuck Music Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Shattuck Music Center features a self-contained suite of practice rooms and 21 grand pianos for student use.
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; some rooms may require sign-up or specific major access.

cards.title: The Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Library Lower Level
cards.notes: Visit the lower level of Todd Wehr Library for drop-in tutoring, writing assistance, and collaborative group study tables.
cards.short_summary: A central academic support hub located in the basement of the main library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning Commons is located in the lower level of the Todd Wehr Memorial Library and offers free academic support services.
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; tutoring schedules vary by subject.

cards.title: Pioneer Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Student Recreation Hub
cards.notes: Access modern cardio and weight equipment using your Pioneer Card; check the late-night hours for post-class workouts.
cards.short_summary: A modern fitness facility for students located on the main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pioneer Fitness Center is a recreation facility available to students with an active Carroll ID.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10 PM Monday-Thursday; requires Carroll ID card swipe for entry.

cards.title: Marceil Pultorak Atrium Gallery
cards.subtitle: Humphrey Memorial Art Center
cards.notes: Walk through the atrium to view rotating exhibitions from the Wisconsin Artists Collection and student capstone projects.
cards.short_summary: An art gallery in the Humphrey Center featuring regional and student works.
cards.evidence_claim: The Marceil Pultorak Atrium Gallery is located in the Humphrey Memorial Art Center and is open Monday-Friday 9 a.m.–6 p.m.
cards.source_title: Art Shows and Galleries - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during academic sessions; closed during university breaks.

cards.title: Diversity Lounge
cards.subtitle: Kilgour Hall
cards.notes: Find this community space in Kilgour Hall, serving as a hub for the Student Involvement Center and multicultural organizations.
cards.short_summary: A community lounge in Kilgour Hall focused on diversity and student involvement.
cards.evidence_claim: Kilgour Hall houses the Student Involvement Center, which includes the Diversity Lounge.
cards.access_notes: Located on the ground floor of Kilgour Hall; accessible to students during building hours.

cards.title: Hastad Hall Green Roof
cards.subtitle: Sustainable Academic Space
cards.notes: Observe the first green roof in Waukesha at this LEED-certified science building, which houses nursing and exercise science labs.
cards.short_summary: A sustainable green roof feature on the modern Hastad Hall academic building.
cards.evidence_claim: Hastad Hall features the first green roof in Waukesha and provides academic space for nursing and exercise science.
cards.source_title: Doug and Nancy Hastad Hall officially opens - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Building is open for classes and study; roof access may be restricted to observation.

cards.title: Paul Fleckenstein Research Laboratory
cards.subtitle: Prairie Springs Center
cards.notes: Join faculty-led environmental research at this off-campus field station featuring trout streams and 75 acres of wetlands.
cards.short_summary: A specialized research lab located at the off-campus Prairie Springs Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Paul Fleckenstein Research Laboratory is located at the Prairie Springs Environmental Education Center, used for environmental science research.
cards.access_notes: Located in Genesee, WI; typically accessed via scheduled lab sessions or research projects.

cards.entity_name: Van Male Field House Indoor Track
cards.title: Van Male Field House Indoor Track
cards.subtitle: Four-Lane Running Surface
cards.notes: Run on the four-lane indoor track during open recreation hours, especially useful during Wisconsin winter months.
cards.short_summary: An indoor running track available for student recreation in the field house.
cards.evidence_claim: Van Male Field House includes a four-lane indoor track and is used for student recreation and intramurals.
cards.source_title: Van Male Fieldhouse - Facilities - Carroll University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open during posted recreation hours; check the athletics calendar for team practice closures.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Explore Carroll University and Waukesha without spending a dime. These student-friendly spots and activities offer free admission and social spaces for all Pioneers.

cards.title: Study at Todd Wehr Library
cards.subtitle: Central Campus Hub
cards.notes: Access quiet study zones and collaborative spaces in the heart of campus. The library is open to students for research and group work at no cost.
cards.short_summary: A central campus library offering free study spaces and academic resources for Carroll students.
cards.evidence_claim: The library provides students a space for collaboration and personalized research assistance at no cost.
cards.access_notes: Open daily during the academic year; check official site for current late-night hours.

cards.title: Peer Tutoring at the Commons
cards.subtitle: Todd Wehr Library Lower Level
cards.notes: Drop in for free academic support, including writing assistance and math tutoring, provided by peer educators in a comfortable social environment.
cards.short_summary: Free academic support and peer tutoring services located in the lower level of the library.
cards.evidence_claim: The LC provides a wide variety of free academic support services for Carroll students.
cards.access_notes: Available to all currently enrolled students during library hours.

cards.title: Weekend Fun with CU@Night
cards.subtitle: Campus-Wide Socials
cards.notes: Attend free Friday and Saturday night events like comedians, DJs, and game nights. These sessions are designed specifically for student entertainment.
cards.short_summary: A student-led program offering free weekend entertainment and social activities on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: CU@Night is always free for Carroll students. Guests of students are also welcome.
cards.source_title: Things to Do on Campus - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Events typically held on Friday and Saturday nights during the semester.

cards.title: View Art at Pultorak Gallery
cards.subtitle: Humphrey Memorial Art Center
cards.notes: Walk through the atrium to see rotating exhibits from the Wisconsin Artists Collection. The gallery is open to the public during school hours.
cards.short_summary: A free campus art gallery showcasing regional works within the Humphrey Memorial Art Center.
cards.evidence_claim: This gallery honors Professor Emeritus of Art Marceil Pultorak and is open Monday–Friday | 9 a.m.–6 p.m.
cards.source_title: Art Shows and Galleries - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Open 9 AM to 6 PM on weekdays when school is in session.

cards.title: Reflect at Humphrey Chapel
cards.subtitle: Spiritual Life Center
cards.notes: Visit this historic space for quiet reflection or attend 'Gather at Humphrey' on Sunday afternoons for music and community connection.
cards.short_summary: A historic on-campus chapel used for worship, meditation, and free community gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Sunday afternoons students come to Gather at Humphrey for music, reflection and community.
cards.access_notes: Open for student use and scheduled spiritual programming.

cards.title: Drop-in Rec at Ganfield Gym
cards.subtitle: Historic Campus Gym
cards.notes: Use your student ID to access the bouldering wall or join a pickup basketball game during open recreation hours in this renovated 1923 landmark.
cards.short_summary: A historic gymnasium offering free open recreation, a bouldering wall, and fitness classes for students.
cards.evidence_claim: RecSports offers... drop-in recreation hours in the fitness center and weight room... Ganfield Gymnasium has a bouldering wall.
cards.access_notes: Carroll ID required for entry; open until 11 PM on weekdays during the semester.

cards.title: Attend a Free Music Recital
cards.subtitle: Shattuck Auditorium
cards.notes: Enjoy live performances by student ensembles and faculty. Most musical events at Shattuck are open to the campus community without a ticket fee.
cards.short_summary: The primary venue for Carroll's musical performances, many of which are free to attend.
cards.evidence_claim: Most of Carroll's musical events take place in Shattuck Music Center.
cards.access_notes: Check the university event calendar for specific free performance dates.

cards.title: Relax on the Main Lawn
cards.subtitle: Campus Green Space
cards.notes: The central green space for sunbathing, frisbee, and outdoor studying. It serves as the primary gathering spot for major campus events like Welcome Week.
cards.short_summary: The iconic central lawn of Carroll University, ideal for free outdoor social activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Parent & guest farewells - Main Lawn... Welcome Week is filled with activities.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space available year-round.

cards.title: Hike the Prairie Trails
cards.subtitle: Genesee Field Station
cards.notes: Explore miles of hiking trails through restored prairies and wetlands. This off-campus site offers a free natural escape for students and the public.
cards.short_summary: An environmental center with free hiking trails and nature education opportunities.
cards.evidence_claim: The center offers opportunities for everyone to connect with nature through a variety of free outdoor education programs.
cards.access_notes: Located a short drive from the main campus; trails are typically open dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Play at Buchner Park
cards.subtitle: Waukesha City Park
cards.notes: Located just blocks from campus, this park features free tennis courts, a playground, and open green space for off-campus recreation.
cards.short_summary: A nearby municipal park offering free athletic courts and recreational space for the community.
cards.evidence_claim: WPRF staff engage children... activities, crafts, and games in the park... Buchner Park Community Pool (note: pool has fees, park is free).
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 6 AM to 10 PM.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Discover the most productive environments across Carroll University, from quiet library carrels to collaborative science labs and rooftop patios.

cards.entity_name: Todd Wehr Memorial Library Reading Room
cards.title: The Second Floor Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Todd Wehr Memorial Library
cards.notes: Head to the second floor for traditional quiet study carrels and a focused atmosphere ideal for deep research and individual work.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet zone on the library's second floor featuring individual study carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has both individual study spaces and areas for group work; for individual study, the best places are the Reading Room and study carrels on the 2nd floor.
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; noise policy strictly enforced in this area.

cards.title: The Lower Level Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Todd Wehr Memorial Library
cards.notes: Access peer tutoring and supplemental instruction in this comfortable hub located in the library's lower level.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub for academic support services and collaborative study located in the library basement.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning Commons (LC) is located in the lower level of the Todd Wehr Memorial Library and offers free academic support services.
cards.access_notes: Study space is open whenever the library building is open.

cards.title: Main Floor Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Todd Wehr Memorial Library
cards.notes: Utilize collaborative computer workstations and printing services in this high-traffic main floor area.
cards.short_summary: A technology-rich collaborative space on the library's main floor with shared computer workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Information Commons on the main floor has several collaborative computer workstations for groups that need to share a computer.
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; includes access to scanners and printers.

cards.title: Library Coffee Shop Lounge
cards.subtitle: Todd Wehr Memorial Library
cards.notes: Grab a drink and find a seat in this social study area on the library's main floor, perfect for casual group work.
cards.short_summary: A social study space located within the library featuring an on-site coffee shop.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has a Coffee Shop on the main floor where anyone can purchase food/drink in Stone Creek Coffee.
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks are permitted in this specific library zone.

cards.title: The Green Roof Patio
cards.subtitle: Doug and Nancy Hastad Hall
cards.notes: Study outdoors with a view of campus on this sustainable rooftop patio featuring Waukesha's first green roof.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor rooftop study space atop the LEED-certified Hastad Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Hastad Hall features a green roof and a rooftop patio which offers a space to host an event while admiring the campus below.
cards.source_title: Hastad Hall sets sustainability standard - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; subject to weather conditions.

cards.title: The DEI Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Kilgour Hall
cards.notes: Find a cozy spot with couches and tables in this inclusive lounge located on the first floor of Kilgour Hall.
cards.short_summary: A welcoming student lounge area within the Office of Diversity, Equity and Inclusion.
cards.evidence_claim: The Office of Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in Kilgour Hall offers an open and cozy student lounge area with couches and tables.
cards.source_title: Diversity, Equity and Inclusion support expands presence - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor; includes microwave and fridge access for students.

cards.title: Jaharis Collaboration Spaces
cards.subtitle: Michael and Mary Jaharis Science Laboratories
cards.notes: Work on group projects in modern, glass-walled collaboration zones throughout this $24 million science facility.
cards.short_summary: Modern collaborative study areas integrated into the university's premier science building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Michael and Mary Jaharis Science Laboratories provide academic spaces and collaboration spaces for students.
cards.access_notes: Primarily used by science majors but open for general academic use during building hours.

cards.title: The Center of Everything
cards.subtitle: Campus Center
cards.notes: Study in the heart of campus activity with easy access to dining, the bookstore, and student organization offices.
cards.short_summary: A central, high-energy study and social area in the main student union building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Center is a place to study, hang out, and access resources; it is described as the 'Center of Everything'.
cards.access_notes: Open late: Mon-Thu until 11:30 PM, Fri-Sat until 12:30 AM.

cards.title: Frontier Hall Study Lounges
cards.subtitle: Frontier Hall
cards.notes: Residents can utilize oversized common area kitchens and study lounges on each floor of this suite-style hall.
cards.short_summary: Floor-specific study lounges and common areas within Frontier Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Frontier Hall features common areas and study lounges, including an oversized common area kitchen on each floor.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to residents for upper floors; ground floor retail areas are public.

cards.title: The Sensory Study Room
cards.subtitle: Todd Wehr Memorial Library
cards.notes: Reserve this specialized room designed for neurodiverse students, providing a controlled environment for focused study.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library study room designed to meet sensory processing needs.
cards.evidence_claim: Room 206 is a Sensory Study Room designed for neurodiverse students, though it is open to all.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Library - Reserve a Room
cards.access_notes: Reservable online for up to 4 hours per day; located in the 2nd floor quiet area.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the historic streets and vibrant corridors of downtown Waukesha, all within a short walk of the Carroll University campus.

cards.title: The Famous Ponza Rotta
cards.subtitle: Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this local staple for a deep-fried Ponza Rotta. It has been a student favorite for affordable, late-night pizza snacks since 1946.
cards.short_summary: A historic pizza shop on Main Street known for its signature deep-fried calzone-style Ponza Rotta.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy's Grotto is located at 314 E. Main St. and is open until 11 PM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Contact Jimmy's - Jimmy's Grotto Ponza Rotta Pizza
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 11:00 AM; stays open until 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday nights.

cards.title: Downtown Coffee Hub
cards.subtitle: Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Study with a latte in the historic Nickell Building. This cafe offers a warm atmosphere and a full menu of fresh-roasted coffee and tea.
cards.short_summary: A well-established coffee shop in a historic downtown building, popular for studying and local gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Steaming Cup is located at 340 W. Main St. in the historic Nickell building.
cards.source_title: The Steaming Cup: Best Coffee & Tea Selections in Waukesha, WI
cards.access_notes: Open daily for indoor seating and carryout; check seasonal hours for evening events.

cards.title: Authentic Artisan Gelato
cards.subtitle: Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Cool off with over 170 flavors of authentic Italian gelato. It is a perfect stop after a walk along the nearby Fox River.
cards.short_summary: A flagship gelato cafe offering a massive variety of artisan flavors and sorbetto in downtown Waukesha.
cards.evidence_claim: Divino Gelato is located at 227 W. Main St. and features 170 flavors of artisan gelato.
cards.access_notes: Located just down the street from the Riverwalk and Frame Park.

cards.title: Nostalgic Candy Wall
cards.subtitle: Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Browse a massive wall of nostalgic candies and hand-crafted truffles. They also serve Chocolate Shoppe ice cream year-round.
cards.short_summary: A local candy shop specializing in artisan chocolates, nostalgic sweets, and premium ice cream.
cards.evidence_claim: Allo! Chocolat is located at 234 W. Main St. and offers hand-crafted chocolates and nostalgic candies.
cards.source_title: Where to Find Us - Allô! Chocolat
cards.access_notes: Open year-round; hours vary by season. Features a sidewalk tent during Friday Night Live.

cards.title: Rooftop Dining Views
cards.subtitle: Clinton Street Corridor
cards.notes: Enjoy brunch or dinner on the rooftop patio. This gastropub is known for its eclectic art and prime people-watching location.
cards.short_summary: A popular downtown gastropub featuring a rooftop patio and a diverse menu of burgers and sandwiches.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor's People's Park is located at 337 W. Main St. at the corner of Clinton and Main.
cards.access_notes: Food is served until 11:00 PM Sunday-Thursday and until Midnight on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: The World's Best Reuben
cards.subtitle: Broadway Corridor
cards.notes: Order a hand-carved corned beef Reuben at this nostalgic deli. It is a top choice for a quick, high-quality lunch near campus.
cards.short_summary: A traditional deli famous for its corned beef sandwiches and nostalgic atmosphere in historic downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Rochester Deli is located at 143 W. Broadway and specializes in hand-carved corned beef.
cards.access_notes: Located in historic downtown; known for fast service during the lunch hour.

cards.title: Dine in a Train Car
cards.subtitle: Williams Street Corridor
cards.notes: Eat authentic Mexican cuisine inside a renovated 1881 train depot. You can even reserve a table inside an actual vintage train car.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican restaurant housed in a historic train station, offering dining in actual train cars.
cards.evidence_claim: La Estacion is located at 319 Williams St. in a historic train station built in 1881.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 11:00 AM; features an active train line passing directly behind the patio.

cards.title: Quiet Study in Cutler Park
cards.subtitle: Wisconsin Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Find a quiet corner to study in this large facility located within Cutler Park. It offers extensive resources and community events.
cards.short_summary: The city's main library, located in a scenic park and offering a peaceful environment for research and reading.
cards.evidence_claim: The Waukesha Public Library is located at 321 Wisconsin Avenue in Cutler Park.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday until 8:30 PM; closed on Sundays.

cards.title: Saturday Morning Tradition
cards.subtitle: St. Paul Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Shop for fresh Wisconsin produce and handmade crafts every Saturday morning. It is a vibrant community gathering spot along the river.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal outdoor market featuring local vendors, fresh food, and artisan goods along the Fox River.
cards.evidence_claim: The Waukesha Farmers Market is held at 125 W. St. Paul Ave. every Saturday from May to October.
cards.access_notes: Open Saturdays from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM, May through October.

cards.title: Riverfront Recreation
cards.subtitle: Frame Park Drive Corridor
cards.notes: Walk or bike the paved trails along the Fox River. The park features formal gardens, an amphitheater, and scenic river views.
cards.short_summary: A 34-acre community park offering extensive trails, gardens, and recreational facilities along the riverfront.
cards.evidence_claim: Frame Park is located at 1200 Frame Park Drive and is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Admission is free; the park includes a riverwalk corridor and bike trails.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals, mascots, and ceremonies that define the Pioneer experience at Wisconsin's first four-year institution.

cards.title: The Piper's Call
cards.subtitle: Opening Convocation and Commencement
cards.notes: Follow the lone bagpiper as they lead the faculty and student procession across campus during major academic ceremonies, a nod to the school's heritage.
cards.short_summary: A ceremonial bagpipe-led march that marks the beginning and end of a student's journey at Carroll.
cards.evidence_claim: A wonderful tradition on my campus both on the first day before classes and again at graduation is to have a bagpiper majestically lead the students on to campus.
cards.source_title: The Siren Song of Bag Pipes Once Again Call Me Back to Carroll Land
cards.access_notes: Visible during public university ceremonies like Opening Convocation and Commencement.

cards.title: Pio Pete's Sideline Spirit
cards.subtitle: Official University Mascot
cards.notes: Look for the buckskin-clad pioneer mascot at athletic events and campus celebrations; he is a central figure in Carroll's 'Pioneer' identity.
cards.short_summary: The official mascot of Carroll University, representing the school's 'Pioneer' nickname at sports and community events.
cards.evidence_claim: Pioneers know and love the familiar figure of Pio Pete... he appeared in parades, braved basketball courts.
cards.source_title: Who - and Where - is Polly Pioneer?
cards.access_notes: Appears at various public athletic events and university-wide celebrations.

cards.title: The Mystery of Polly Pioneer
cards.subtitle: Historical Secondary Mascot
cards.notes: Learn about Polly, the buckskin-wearing female mascot who appeared alongside Pete in the 1970s and returned as a 'human' mascot in 1997.
cards.short_summary: A historical secondary mascot whose legacy is celebrated through archival stories and occasional modern appearances.
cards.evidence_claim: Polly was often seen around campus hanging out with Pio Pete... this human version debuted in 1997.
cards.source_title: Who - and Where - is Polly Pioneer?
cards.access_notes: Legacy documented in university archives and F1RST magazine.

cards.title: Living the Ethos
cards.subtitle: Annual Values Reflection
cards.notes: Participate in this day-long event focused on respect, integrity, and stewardship, featuring workshops and a cultural market.
cards.short_summary: An annual university-wide event dedicated to exploring and practicing the Carroll University Ethos.
cards.evidence_claim: Carroll University's 6th Annual Ethos Symposium was a day-long event that provided a space for reflection and fostering transformative learning experiences.
cards.source_title: BALANCING ACT: - Carroll Remains Financially Sound
cards.access_notes: Open to students, faculty, staff, and the community.

cards.title: Ringing the Victory Bell
cards.subtitle: Commencement Tradition
cards.notes: Listen for the bell behind Old Main, which is traditionally rung to celebrate commencement and significant university milestones.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing tradition where a bell is rung to signal the completion of studies and other campus victories.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus walks and the victory bell will provide a reminiscent setting for the commencement... behind Old Main.
cards.access_notes: Located on the lawn behind Old Main; typically rung during graduation ceremonies.

cards.title: Founders Day Convocation
cards.subtitle: Celebrating University Origins
cards.notes: Attend the formal gathering that honors the university's 1846 charter and the individuals who established Wisconsin's first college.
cards.short_summary: An annual academic ceremony commemorating the founding of Carroll University.
cards.evidence_claim: The first Founders' Day Convocation is observed... Founders Day Convocation programs, 2000-present.
cards.access_notes: Held annually, typically in the Shattuck Music Center or Main Hall.

cards.title: Blessing of the Graduates
cards.subtitle: Baccalaureate Service
cards.notes: Join this multi-faith service where graduating seniors receive a formal blessing before their commencement ceremony.
cards.short_summary: A spiritual tradition held during commencement week to honor the journey of the graduating class.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baccalaureate service honors Carroll's religious heritage and culminates with a special blessing for the Class of 2027.
cards.access_notes: Held in Shattuck Auditorium; open to graduates and their families.

cards.title: Pio4Life Cap Decorating
cards.subtitle: Commencement Creative Tradition
cards.notes: Express your personality by decorating your graduation cap for a chance to win prizes in this annual commencement contest.
cards.short_summary: A creative tradition where seniors decorate their mortarboards for the graduation ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: PIO4LIFE CAP CONTEST Show off your personality and your pioneer pride by decorating your cap for commencement!
cards.access_notes: Participation is open to all graduating seniors.

cards.title: Golden Pioneer Pinning
cards.subtitle: 50th Reunion Ceremony
cards.notes: Watch as alumni celebrating their 50th graduation anniversary are officially inducted as 'Golden Pioneers' during Homecoming weekend.
cards.short_summary: A ceremony honoring alumni who graduated 50 or more years ago.
cards.evidence_claim: 50th Reunion Dinner & Golden Pioneer Pinning Ceremony... Pioneers from the Class of 1976 will gather for this pinning ceremony.
cards.access_notes: Typically held in the Stackner Ballroom during Homecoming weekend.

cards.title: CUonGivingTuesday
cards.subtitle: Annual Day of Giving
cards.notes: Join the campus-wide effort to support student scholarships and programs during this high-energy annual fundraising tradition.
cards.short_summary: A modern tradition of community giving that supports the university's mission and students.
cards.evidence_claim: CUonGivingTuesday is the perfect way to kick off the giving season by supporting something meaningful—Carroll University students!
cards.access_notes: A digital and campus-wide event held annually in late November or early December.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Carroll University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A guide to the essential events and locations for new Pioneers during their first weekend on campus in Waukesha.

cards.title: Move-In Morning
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning Arrival
cards.notes: Check in at your assigned residence hall to receive your keys and Pioneer Card. Volunteers are available to help unload vehicles during designated time slots.
cards.short_summary: The official start of the first weekend where students move into campus housing.
cards.evidence_claim: First-year Student Move-In Day for Fall 2026 is scheduled for Friday, August 28, 2026.
cards.source_title: Campus and Student Life - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Access is restricted to students with valid housing assignments and their families.

cards.title: President's Welcome Lunch
cards.subtitle: Friday Midday Meal
cards.notes: Join the university president for a formal welcome lunch in the Main Dining Room. This is a key opportunity for families to dine together before farewells.
cards.short_summary: A traditional welcome meal for new students and their families hosted by the university president.
cards.evidence_claim: The President's Lunch is held Friday, Aug. 28, 2026, from 11:30 a.m. - 1:30 p.m. in the Campus Center Main Dining Room.
cards.access_notes: Open to new students and their families during orientation weekend.

cards.title: Opening Convocation
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Ceremony
cards.notes: Walk through the Carroll Arch to Shattuck Auditorium for the official academic induction ceremony. This marks the formal beginning of your college career.
cards.short_summary: The formal academic ceremony welcoming the new class to the university community.
cards.evidence_claim: Opening Convocation takes place Friday, Aug. 28, 2026, at 2:45 p.m. starting at the Carroll Arch and moving to Shattuck Auditorium.
cards.access_notes: Required for all new students; families are invited to attend.

cards.title: Family Farewells
cards.subtitle: Friday Late Afternoon
cards.notes: Gather on the Main Lawn for final goodbyes with parents and guests before students transition into their first evening of peer-focused activities.
cards.short_summary: A designated time and place for students to say goodbye to their families.
cards.evidence_claim: Parent and guest farewells are scheduled for 4:00 - 4:15 p.m. on the Main Lawn on Friday of Welcome Week.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public space on campus.

cards.title: CU@Night Social
cards.subtitle: Friday Night Entertainment
cards.notes: Head to the Campus Center for late-night entertainment including comedians, DJs, or game nights. These events are designed to help you meet other new students.
cards.short_summary: A late-night social programming series for students held on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.evidence_claim: CU@Night offers free Friday and Saturday night programming such as musicians, DJs, and game nights for Carroll students.
cards.source_title: Things to Do on Campus - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Free for all Carroll students; usually starts in the evening and runs late.

cards.title: Campus Scavenger Hunt
cards.subtitle: Saturday Evening Activity
cards.notes: Participate in a team-based scavenger hunt to learn the layout of the campus and discover important resources while competing for prizes.
cards.short_summary: A fun, interactive way for new students to explore the campus and build teamwork.
cards.evidence_claim: A scavenger hunt evening program is scheduled for Saturday, August 29, 2026, at 7 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open to all first-year students as part of orientation.

cards.title: Orientation Chapel
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Service
cards.notes: Attend an optional interfaith chapel service to reflect on the transition to college life. The chapel is a quiet space for spiritual connection.
cards.short_summary: An optional spiritual service held for students during the orientation weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: An optional Chapel for Orientation event is scheduled for Sunday, August 30, 2026, at 9:30 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Optional event open to all students.

cards.title: Fire and Ice Social
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening Gathering
cards.notes: Enjoy a themed social event featuring treats and music. This is one of the final large-group gatherings before classes begin on Monday.
cards.short_summary: A themed social gathering for new students to celebrate the end of orientation weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Fire and Ice' evening program is scheduled for Sunday, August 30, 2026, from 8 - 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Evening event for first-year students.

cards.title: RecSports Open House
cards.subtitle: Weekend Recreation
cards.notes: Visit the historic Ganfield Gymnasium to learn about intramural sports, group fitness classes, and equipment rentals like bikes and kayaks.
cards.short_summary: The hub for campus recreation and fitness activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Ganfield Gymnasium hosts free group fitness classes and provides equipment check-out through RecSports.
cards.access_notes: Open to students with a valid Pioneer Card.

cards.title: Downtown Discovery
cards.subtitle: Weekend Off-Campus Walk
cards.notes: Take a short walk to downtown Waukesha to explore local coffee shops, the riverfront trail, and the Saturday morning farmers market.
cards.short_summary: An opportunity for students to explore the local community surrounding the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Carroll is located blocks from downtown Waukesha, which features a farmers market every Saturday morning from May to October.
cards.access_notes: Public city district accessible by walking from campus.
